title: Declared workspace entrypoint is missing the workspace manifest
reasoning: The owned workspace bundle contains SwiftPM resolution metadata but no contents.xcworkspacedata file. That means the claimed entrypoint is not a valid Xcode workspace; a workspace-based build or inspection path such as xcodebuild -workspace Grove.xcodeproj/project.xcworkspace will reject it instead of discovering the Grove project and scheme.
reproduction: Run xcodebuild -list -workspace Grove.xcodeproj/project.xcworkspace; Xcode reports that the path is not a workspace file.
recommendation: Either add a valid Grove.xcodeproj/project.xcworkspace/contents.xcworkspacedata file that points at the project, or update build/discovery tooling to treat Grove.xcodeproj itself as the project entrypoint rather than using the internal workspace path.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided for the workspace bundle shape, and target-level tests only run after Xcode has already accepted and resolved the project/workspace entrypoint.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a CI smoke check that verifies Grove.xcodeproj/project.xcworkspace/contents.xcworkspacedata exists and that xcodebuild -list can resolve the intended Xcode entrypoint.
minimumFixScope: Workspace metadata only: restore the missing contents.xcworkspacedata file or change the semantic entrypoint/build scripts to use Grove.xcodeproj.
